intro: The Hunter's Path is a rite of passage directing young orc and troll hunters to Razor Hill. Under the guidance of master hunter Thotar, fledgling trackers learn the vital discipline of binding wild predators to their will.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hello, young hunter. You look to me like you are skilled enough to handle a beast and train it as your companion.
You must see Thotar at Razor Hill. He can put you on the path to earning a pet of your own.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes, it is time for you to begin your training.
